title: Nucleic Acid Purification Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Perform nucleic acid purification
steps.instruction: Run the custom nucleic acid purification on up to 96 samples using the Opentrons Magnetic Module GEN2 and Beckman Coulter Ampure XP Reagent for PCR Purification. The protocol will prompt you to refill tipracks when necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files that have .json extensions, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload your protocol file that has a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette. Consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.
